title: How do I change the text when a chest is opened?

posts.author: KingChris825
posts.body:
As the title states, how do I do it? Changing the default text when I create a treasure chest in getting annoying lol. I've tried looking in the default scripts, but can't find it. Can someone help me?
Edit: I forgot to mention that a friend recently gifted me RPG Maker VX Ace.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You don't. Scripts can't change the editor.
You could make a chest with the text you want and copy and paste that event instead of making a new quick event.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
Actually I second the common event method.
You can set as much or as little in the common events as you want. If all your text is the same regardless of the item, then you can just put the text in the common event and then leave the actual item acquisition inside the chest event.
If you have only a handful of items the player may run across, you can just create a common event for each one of those items. Like a potion common event, ether common event, phoenix down common event, etc.
You will still need to assign the common event to the chest event, but at least you aren't typing it all out.
As a side note, if you making your player read the same text over and over again, you may want to reconsider how you handle your chests. You could track when it's the player's first time to receive a potion, say the potion text, then enable a switch. Assuming that text and switch command is in a conditional for the switch to be OFF, then going forward, that text will never be shown again.
As an alternative, you could keep a notepad with the common text that you use pre-written on it.
Then whenever you make chests, just highlight, copy-paste into the text box.
